title: Awesome digital planner, just a couple things I’d like to see
body:
I’ve been using this app for a couple months now (I did buy the premium version). My ADHD brain doesn’t like to stick to planners, but this one has stuck with me so far! The visual elements are helpful because I can color code everything and assign tasks symbols that make sense to me. I REALLY love that when you finish a task, it gets crossed off your list. It’s so satisfying and makes it easy to see what you still need to do. 

All that said, there are a couple things I’d like to see added/changed. 
1) This seems to be a more recent issue, so maybe it is because of a recent update. For the past couple weeks I’ve been getting Lock Screen notifications for tasks that are finished and have been marked completed. Often times it continues to give me notifications for two or more hours after I’ve completed the task, and after it was scheduled to end. 
2) I know there’s the inbox for unsorted tasks, but I’d love to see a place for weekly and monthly goals. Things that I want to get done that don’t need to be scheduled for a specific time, but still have a deadline. I’m an artist who works from home, so having a place to put my weekly and monthly goals for projects and to-dos would be very helpful for me.

title: Amazing!
body:
I have ADHD and have probably spend hundreds of $$ on planners just to use them for a few weeks and then forget they exist. I started a new job in September after graduating college in May and I am on my Mac for my job all the time. This app is finally a Planner I won't forget about. I can leave it open on my screen and it follows me along through my work tasks for the day. Plus I get to check tasks off as I complete them, which I LOVE because dopamine is the ruler of my ADHD brain. I love all the color options because I can color coordinate to my hearts content. 

One of my favorite features of this app is the Inbox. I have so many fleeting thoughts thoughout the day and sometimes those thoughts have nothing to do with what I am currently working on. When I get the random thought about needing to order groceries some time in the next week or pay a bill before the end of the month, I can quickly create a task in the app and leave it in the "Inbox" space. Then when I am ready and decide what day and time I want to schedule that task for I can go back in and edit that task and schedule it where I want it. Its the perfect idea for having a pending to-do list right next to my daily tasks. Then on days when I finish my daily tasks for the day quicker then planned I can check my Inbox and see if there is anything I need to do that i can schedule into my day. 

I also love the one time purchase option instead of subscription. I HATE subscrition based apps. I'd rather pay once and have it forever. Please keep your one-time payment option!

title: Plan your Day with Elegance and Ease
body: Structured is an incredible planner app. The interface is very elegant and simple to use. You can add tasks or events for various times throughout the day, all while making those tasks and events decorative with their own unique colors and custom icons. Structured also allows Pro users, for a one-time fee, to receive notifications of tasks and events, to import Calendar events, to import from Reminders, and to setup recurring events. Structured also, unlike many other apps out there, has a fantastic privacy policy that collects only the personal data that is required for the app to function properly. title: Perfect app and fair pricing
body:
This app with a sole developer, great features, and one-time affordable price deserves 5 starts. However, I have some suggestions:
1. Add menu items, or shortcuts to:
- Show all uncompleted tasks sortable by time (i.e., oldest first or newsest first)
- Navigate to "today"

2. Drag and drop tasks to change their times quickly (similar to the google calendar and sorted 3), preferably being able to select multiple tasks (similar to sorted 3). If drag and drop is complex, then adding a "shift X minutes forward" for each task would help as well. 

3. Being able to turn off notifications for some of the tasks. Similar to calendar tasks that is already there. For example, I don't want to get a notification for watching a movie at night, because I do it anyway!

title: Game changer
body:
I’m not exaggerating when I say this app has majorly improved my life. As someone with ADHD and therefore impaired executive functioning, I honestly didn’t believe I was capable of getting done everything I need to in a day. This app has taught me the importance of having the right tools. 

I have used an insane amount of task and scheduling apps and this is the one I’ve stuck with the longest and has erased the itch to try any others (no small feat, I had a productivity app addiction problem 😅). Other apps were either just not quite it or they have a pricey subscription model (I’m looking at you, Tiimo). 

I love that Structured gets regular improvements and updates. Every time I’ve wished for a function or that something would work a little differently, lo and behold, the next update brings that exact thing. This dev team is seriously on it and you get the feeling they actually care about making their app the best it can be for the user. One of the few times I was actually happy to pay for Pro. 

There are just a few things I’d like to suggest for future updates. You guys probably have it on the list already, but just in case 😉 I was going to suggest the subtasks being movable but that came with the last update! Man, that’s gonna make things easier. Now if events on the calendar could be movable that would be awesome. Instead of having to go into the event and adjust the time, being able to just drag it (think Google Calendar). Then if there were the option of having unfinished tasks automatically roll over to the next day. Just cutting out some of the things that have to be done manually at the moment, taking up time and mental space. 

Honestly, right now I can’t even think of anything else I would change! This app is near perfect and I’m so appreciative for it! Keep up the great work, guys 😄

title: Please Fix Problem with Re-Occurring Subtasks
body:
When I first downloaded this app I fell in love with the features, it had everything I’ve been searching for in a “to-do list” app for years. Sadly, the very feature that I fell in love with in the app has become very glitchy. The feature that I’m referring to are the subtasks that you can add under your main task. The subtask feature is what I’ve been searching for, because it allows me to add individual items that I need to do for each task and check them off as I complete them. I also use the subtasks to track my daily supplements, which has been extremely helpful in ensuring that I’m not missing any. I have about 6 main tasks that I’ve set up as re-occurring daily, and under those 6 main tasks I have a list of subtasks that coincide with them. 

Here’s the Problem: The subtasks are supposed to uncheck themselves under the re-occurring tasks daily, as this occurred when I first downloaded the app. However, about 2 weeks ago I began to notice that at the start of a new day some of my re-occurring subtasks would be randomly checked off. At first this was only happening to a few of my re-occurring subtasks, and now it’s happening to a lot of them. It’s now becoming an inconvenience, and I’m very disappointed because this feature is why I use the app. Please fix this problem as soon as possible, and unsure that re-occurring subtasks are unchecking each day. Will update rating once fixed.

title: It was great, until…
body:
I started off LOVING this app. I quickly paid for the full version and was thrilled with how it integrates with my google calendar. After a few weeks I got a new email and tried to add the calendar from it but couldn’t. So I reached out to support for guidance and they said (paraphrasing) ‘We don’t know what’s wrong. Use the add a calendar option in settings (which I don’t have). You’re on your own.’  This was truly disappointing. To make something so great and then have such terrible customer service. So basically, I can only add events by entering them manually. So what did I even pay for? At the end of the day, when it works, it works great! But don’t expect much help of you encounter an issue.

Updated 1/25 - I was hopeful my initial 3 star review would gain the attention of the developers and I’d get to better assistance with my issue. As this has not happened, I can no longer recommend the app. Entering all my events manually completely defeats the purpose of this app for me. If I input an event on my Google calendar on my computer and it doesn’t sync with Structured it’s not useful. Super disappointed.

title: Your Productivity Superpower!
body:
Do you use multiple task management & calendar apps? You NEED Structured.

Summary:
Structured is THE innovative, simple-but-powerful, visual task & calendar(s) management superpower for anyone who wants an app to help manage their busy lives without becoming a task itself!

No subscriptions. No invasive or hidden permissions. Just what you need to outline your day, see what’s next, and get things done (GTD). 

 Pros:
(+) Simple, intuitive, and powerful,
(+) Add sub tasks (including to calendar events),
(+) Customizable task duration (default: 1 min),
(+) Duplicate common tasks quick/easy in app,
(+) Connect/Sync any/all iOS Calendar(s),
(+) Connect/Sync any/all iOS Reminders (as lists),
(+) Connect to video calls directly from the app,
(+) Highly-customizable (colors, app & task icons),
(+) Effective visual schedule management,
(+) Best in class value (NO subscriptions),
(+) Non-invasive (transparent permissions),
(+) Multi-function widgets (S/M/L),
(+) iCloud sync (optional),
(+) Easily find & fill downtime in your schedule,
(+) Customizable notifications (thank you!),
(+) Easily inbound & store tasks without due dates,
(+) Privacy-oriented, you control your data,
(+) *No subscriptions!!! One-time, low-cost fee.

Cons:
(-) No native support for Google Tasks,
(-) No native support for other GTD apps (ToDoist),
(-) **iOS calendars only (no direct account access),
(-) No invitee information in calendar events,
(-) No calendar grouping (eg “work” or “personal”),
(-) Limited task grouping (only by color),
(-) Can’t change default task duration,
(-) Can’t customize widgets (eg edit calendar set),
(-) Can’t attach files,
(-) ***All details are added as “sub tasks”.

Notes:
* There is a “free” version, but its practicality is limited.

** You can see any calendar you link via Apple ID (Apple Calendar accounts), but you can’t directly link Google/Gmail, Exchange, CalDav, IMAP, etc…

*** You will see most details, but they are presented as sub tasks, not as “location”, “notes”, etc…

Conclusion:
I’ve tried everything else. Structured is the closest to meeting my needs of any app available. It’s simple, intuitive, and powerful visual schedule and task management system will enable your most productive self. 

There are gaps, but they are mostly resolved with simple work-arounds. 

For the price (did I mention no subscriptions?) there is no more useful, high-potential tool out there. Give it a shot, you have everything to gain!

body:

That is, even with an 8-hour event I can still always see the events above and below it, and I find being able to contextualise each piece of my day to be very helpful. And icing on the cake is how beautifully simple (and pretty much intuitive) the interface is. I also get a lot of use out of its more granular features like subtasks. Very well conceived and executed.

I’m satisfied having paid for the pro version and I hope this app is successful! I’m honestly surprised it doesn’t have a higher profile among the other productivity apps out there already and feel lucky I stumbled onto it.

title: BEST TIME BLOCKING APP EVER!!!
body:
I cannot believe I finally found the app that I was dreaming about!!!! 

This app does everything I could think of and more! First I want to thank the developers for making it an affordable ONE TIME FEE and not a subscription base app. Most apps now require a monthly or yearly subscription which is very frustrating when you are working with a tight budget. So Thank you! ❤️ 

 Second, I recently transitioned to a new position and I work from home now. I love it, but time management has been tricky to say the least since I have more unstructured time. This app helps me plan my day and see when I have “free time” to add things from my to-do list (i.e. the inbox feature) 

 Things I LOVE:
 - Helps me structure my day to avoid so many unproductive hours.
 - I can finally Implement morning and evening routines (habits I want to building) without cluttering my google calendar (I was using google calendar to time block but it made my calendar look sooooo cluttered and I hated it) 
 - syncs with Google Calendar which helps add events to my day - I love the feeling of scratching things off when I am done with a task and this is perfect for that! The only thing that gave me that satisfaction was paper and pen, but I needed an app bc I prefer things on my phone (who has time to be caring a notepad lol) - Free time or plan your next task feature bc it tells you exactly the time frame you have which encourages you to add something in instead of being just “unproductive time” 
 - the app just looks visually pleasing, and the reminders are great! 

 Wish list for future updates: 
-More Icon options( I.e. church, family time, etc) - extra line of favorite colors.
- The inbox feature to have the options to create folders (like Personal, Work, Church, etc.) I think this can help to categorize future tasks. 
-Due Date/Deadline for a task.  I think this will help to ensure no task is left forgotten in the inbox & that you remember to make time to complete it. 

 THIS APP IS AWESOME AND TOTALLY WORTH THE ONE TIME FEE! WILL BE RECOMMENDING IT TO EVERYONE! GREAT JOB ON YHIS AMAZING APP ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

title: Just needs 2 more features and it’ll be 5 stars!
body:
I really love this app — the concept is great, and I bought it over other options both for the ability to integrate to-dos and calendar AND because it is so much more beautiful than other options. The calm and understated colors and shapes make me enjoy scheduling my day, which would normally be a stressful task. <3

And I am so impressed this is made by a student and not a big corporation.

There are only two things it needs to be 5-stars, and as soon as these appear I will happily update my review:
1) snooze/delay button for when you’re running behind so that the current task and all the ones below it get snoozed/delayed by a specified amount of time (only the tasks, not the imported calendar items, which obviously need to stay stable)
2) the ability to press-and-hold on a task to active a drag-and-drop/move option to switch/reorder tasks. Currently it’s very time consuming to rearrange tasks, and the pressure-touch or press-and-hold options on the iPhone seem like a really clear solution to this problem.

I hope you can update soon! <3

title: I can FINALLY stop searching 😭💖
body: THIS APP IS AN ABSOLUTE DREAM COME TRUE. If I had a disposable income I’d do everything in my power to make sure Structured stays alive and healthy forever. This is the first time I’ve ever written a review for an app—as someone who hates the idea of even responding to texts and emails, I can’t overstate what a huge thing it is for me to actually sit down and type this out. I’ve downloaded more apps for scheduling than I can count. Most recently I spent LITERALLY THREE DAYS just downloading and trying scheduling apps, desperately looking for one that I’d jive with and wouldn’t be a total nightmare to adjust to. This includes Tiimo and other apps that claim to be easy for neurodiverse users to navigate. I’m a visual and tactile learner. I have a neurodiverse brain. I’m an artist and filmmaker. I run a business. And I have more weird projects on my plate than Benjamin Franklin and Martha Stewart combined. Structured is sheer perfection—like a magical app elf knew exactly what I needed and presented it to me on a golden platter. There are minor bugs that I hope will get worked out—like issues with the widget syncing and not having an Apple Watch app—but even with those inconveniences, this BLOWS AWAY everything else in the App Store (yes, I obsessively scrolled literally to the end of the search results for scheduling app in the App Store and tried every single one that seemed vaguely decent, even the ones with less than 30 reviews). Let my insane research save you hours of eye strain headaches, frustration, and wasted time—JUST DOWNLOAD THIS APP NOW AND GET THE PRO VERSION. Even if you don’t wind up totally loving it for some reason, at least you’ll be helping keep this app alive, supporting a talented developer who’s clearly bound for legendary status, AND in a roundabout way helping artists and neurodiverse people of all kinds who will love this app—and for that, I personally thank you, random App Store stranger 💖

I've been looking for an app where I can plan out my day forever. I've been trying numerous options and none was really fitting my needs. I love the simplicity of Structured and how efficient it is. My days are pretty hectic with not much room left for any spare time since I have multiple projects and jobs going on at the same time as a freelancer. This is also why my schedule isn't the same everyday and it keeps changing. 

The only thing that I'm missing is a "snooze" option. It happens quite often that I run behind with a task and I wish I could snooze it for lets say 5, 10, 15, 30 Minutes to an hour and that all the following tasks would be moved in time accordingly because I don't have time to reschedule all the following tasks manually and then I start feeling stressed out when the next tasks comes up already and I haven't even finished the current one, and so on. Other than that it is simply amazing and perfect.

If you are in need of an awesome daily planner, look no further and download Structured and don't forget to tip the developer 😊

title: I rarely leave reviews...
body:
💞 I am in love with this app! 
First let me say this — I have been a constant searcher on the App Store for the “perfect planner”. I am consistently deleting apps, finding them not useful for my life (freelancer, graphic designer, stay at home/homeschool mom). It’s a bit hectic. So staying focused on just ONE ☝🏻 task is hard for me (and my homeschooled daughter). 

This app seriously works SO well for myself and my daughter. It keeps us both on task and helps me organize the day a million times better than a regular written planner or any other app has.

I ALSO LOVE THAT IT’S FREE?!! 💰!!
Of course, I tipped the “buy me a coffee” amount, because I truly am so appreciative of what an amazing job they have done! But, also, because they aren’t overwhelmingly annoying with ads about tipping them any money. 

The next tip will probably be a “dinner on me”, because I can’t see this app getting worse when all it’s been since I’ve downloaded it is amazing and perfect. 

TL;DR
Y’all are the sh*t. This app is the sh*t. 
Just download it.
